targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]哎，该难过的是俺！真不敢信，俺的手艺居然没撑住！
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]哎，该难过的是俺！真不敢信，俺的手艺居然没撑住！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]It was an old bridge, and wasn’t designed with that weight in mind necessarily… But still!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]那桥是有些年头了，造的时候，也确实没考虑过那么重的分量……可话虽如此！
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]那桥是有些年头了，造的时候，也确实没考虑过那么重的分量……可话虽如此！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Is he around? I’d love to have a chat with him.
He’s just at the opening to the plains.

targets.oldTarget: 他就在通往平原的入口那儿。
targets.newTarget: 他就在通往平原的入口那儿。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]Ok! I’ll see if I can reach out to him.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]好嘞！俺看看能不能去找他聊聊。
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]好嘞！俺看看能不能去找他聊聊。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Ah, I’m a bottom for sure!
[pic=1]When it comes to other folks, I really just want them to take the lead.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]跟别人亲热，我就是想让对方来带着我。
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]跟别人亲热，我就是想让对方来带着我。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Though, a lot of that might be due to some insecurities I have with my uh, body parts…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]不过，这可能有很大一部分，是因为我对自己的，呃，身体部位……有些没自信。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]不过，这可能有很大一部分，是因为我对自己的，呃，身体部位……有些没自信。

fields.Dialogue Text: You look great!
[pic=3]No, that’s not what I mean.
[pic=3]A lot of folks see a beak and sharp claws, and don’t want that going near their sensitive bits…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]好多人一看见喙和尖爪，就不想让它们靠近自己的敏感部位……
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]好多人一看见喙和尖爪，就不想让它们靠近自己的敏感部位……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]But I’m very gentle and have a lot of finesse!
[pic=6]I mean, I’ve been using them on myself for years, you pick up a thing or two, bahaw!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]我是说，我都用它们伺候自己好多年了，总会学到点本事嘛，哇哈！
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]我是说，我都用它们伺候自己好多年了，总会学到点本事嘛，哇哈！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Still, I understand folks aprehension.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]不过，我也理解大家为什么顾虑。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]不过，我也理解大家为什么顾虑。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]Plus, I really don’t mind other critters doing most of the work!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]再说，我也完全不介意让别的动物居民来出大部分的力！
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]再说，我也完全不介意让别的动物居民来出大部分的力！

fields.Dialogue Text: Top or bottom?
Bucky
[pic=3]Oh good ole Barnaby!
[pic=2]He and I have been neighbors forever. He’s so helpful and handy!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]我跟他当邻居都多少年了。他特别热心，手艺也好！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]我跟他当邻居都多少年了。他特别热心，手艺也好！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]I’ve had him over many times to fix up the house! He’s always happy to be of service.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]我请他来家里修修补补，都请过好多回了！他总是乐意帮忙。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]我请他来家里修修补补，都请过好多回了！他总是乐意帮忙。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]… Y’know…
[pic=3]Despite him favoring the male critters, he used to swing with my husband and I back in the day!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]虽然他更喜欢雄性动物居民，可当年也跟我和丈夫一起玩过伴侣共享呢！
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]虽然他更喜欢雄性动物居民，可当年也跟我和丈夫一起玩过伴侣共享呢！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]It’s clear he was in it more for my husband, but he was a gentleman to me all the same!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]看得出来，他主要是冲着我丈夫来的，不过对我也一样有绅士风度！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]看得出来，他主要是冲着我丈夫来的，不过对我也一样有绅士风度！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]All this talk has got me craving beaver…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]聊着聊着，倒勾得我想尝尝“河狸”的滋味了……
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]聊着聊着，倒勾得我想尝尝“河狸”的滋味了……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]…and I don’t mean vagina!
So, you broke the bridge?
[pic=5]Gosh, yeah.
[pic=6]And I feel just awful about it.
[pic=3]I don’t even really know these guys too well y’know? I came here just a few weeks ago!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]你知道吗，我跟这里的大家都还不太熟呢？我几周前才来的！
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]你知道吗，我跟这里的大家都还不太熟呢？我几周前才来的！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]We never really broke the ice… I’ve gone ahead and jumped way past that and broke the bridge!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]我们都还没来得及破冰熟络一下……我倒好，直接跳过破冰，把桥弄断了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]我们都还没来得及破冰熟络一下……我倒好，直接跳过破冰，把桥弄断了！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]I’m the worst, guh.

I think you’re being
a little hard on yourself.

targets.oldTarget:
我觉得你对自己
有点太苛刻了。
targets.newTarget:
我觉得你对自己
有点太苛刻了。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]I’ve always been pretty self conscious and critical. But like, can you blame me? I BROKE THEIR BRIDGE!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]我一直都很在意别人怎么看我，也总是挑自己的毛病。可出了这事，我能不自责吗？我把人家的桥弄断了啊！
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]我一直都很在意别人怎么看我，也总是挑自己的毛病。可出了这事，我能不自责吗？我把人家的桥弄断了啊！

fields.Dialogue Text: Have you talked to them about it?

targets.oldTarget: 你跟大家谈过这件事吗？
targets.newTarget: 你跟大家谈过这件事吗？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]I can’t bring myself to do it.

But you’ve been sticking around here?
Why don’t you leave?

targets.oldTarget:
可你一直待在这里？
为什么不离开呢？
targets.newTarget:
可你一直待在这里？
为什么不离开呢？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]That would be even worse! I can’t just break something and go??

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]那不是更糟吗！我总不能弄坏了东西就一走了之吧？？
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]那不是更糟吗！我总不能弄坏了东西就一走了之吧？？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]I’ve been biding my time, hoping to get up the courage to try to make things right…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]我一直等着，希望自己能攒够勇气，想办法弥补……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]我一直等着，希望自己能攒够勇气，想办法弥补……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]But gosh it’s been hard. I don’t know where to start.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]可是真的好难。我都不知道该从哪里开始。
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]可是真的好难。我都不知道该从哪里开始。

fields.Dialogue Text:
You should start
by talking to them.

targets.oldTarget:
你应该先
跟大家谈谈。
targets.newTarget:
你应该先
跟大家谈谈。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]I know… It’s just, been hard…
What if I talk to them?
[pic=5]I’d… hate to ask that of you…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]我……真不好意思让你帮这种忙……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]我……真不好意思让你帮这种忙……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Maybe you can just, like, put some feelers out there?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]也许你可以，就是，帮我探探口风？
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]也许你可以，就是，帮我探探口风？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Get a read on the situation?
[pic=5]“Hey what do you feel about that jerk-wad who broke the bridge” – y’know something like that…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]“嘿，你们怎么看那个把桥弄断的混蛋？”——你知道的，就像这样……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]“嘿，你们怎么看那个把桥弄断的混蛋？”——你知道的，就像这样……

fields.Dialogue Text: Haha, ok will do.
[pic=2]Heh, kindred spirits then!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]嘿嘿，那我们算是同道中人了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]嘿嘿，那我们算是同道中人了！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]I’m really glad to be here, though.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]不过，我真的很高兴能来到这里。
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]不过，我真的很高兴能来到这里。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]Truth be told, I’m not exactly a "big catch" for the ladies back where I’m from. No males wanting to experiment either.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]说实话，在老家，我可算不上姑娘们眼里的“抢手货”。也没有男的愿意跟我试试。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]说实话，在老家，我可算不上姑娘们眼里的“抢手货”。也没有男的愿意跟我试试。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Similar story for you?
Yeah, pretty much.
[pic=5]It appears their language had something more to it than simply speech…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]他们的语言似乎不只有口头表达，还包含别的东西……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]他们的语言似乎不只有口头表达，还包含别的东西……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]I believe the scriptures are not complete on their own… but simply, an aid.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]我认为，那些铭文本身并不完整……只是某种辅助。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]我认为，那些铭文本身并不完整……只是某种辅助。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]So without the missing pieces, what we end up having is a small fraction of the story.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]所以缺少了那些部分，我们手里剩下的，就只是整个故事的一小部分。
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]所以缺少了那些部分，我们手里剩下的，就只是整个故事的一小部分。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]Unfortunately, the few things I have gathered basically confirm the rumors.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]遗憾的是，我搜集到的少量信息，基本上证实了那些传闻。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]遗憾的是，我搜集到的少量信息，基本上证实了那些传闻。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Critters of all kinds gathered here to share delight in pleasures of the flesh.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]各种动物居民聚集在这里，共享肉体的欢愉。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]各种动物居民聚集在这里，共享肉体的欢愉。

fields.Dialogue Text: Business Ventures?
[pic=4]Oh for sure!
[pic=4]I’m always thinking of ways to provide a service!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]我总在琢磨，能给大家提供些什么服务！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]我总在琢磨，能给大家提供些什么服务！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5](and make a little extra coin on the side.)
[pic=3]The shop is my 7th venture! Though, it’s technically the 6th repurposed.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]这家店是我第7次创业！不过严格来说，是第6次的转型。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]这家店是我第7次创业！不过严格来说，是第6次的转型。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]See, I came from a family of Clam Shuckers hence the name.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]你看，我出身于剥蛤人的家庭，所以才有了这个姓。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]你看，我出身于剥蛤人的家庭，所以才有了这个姓。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]And all day every day was gathering and shucking clams. It was the worst.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]天天从早到晚就是捡蛤、剥蛤。简直糟透了。
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]天天从早到晚就是捡蛤、剥蛤。简直糟透了。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]I needed to spread my webs y’know?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]我也得舒展舒展蹼爪，出去闯闯，你说是吧？
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]我也得舒展舒展蹼爪，出去闯闯，你说是吧？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Plenty of problems to fix, systems to innovate, and coin to make!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]有的是问题等着解决，有的是办法等着创新，还有的是硬币等着赚！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]有的是问题等着解决，有的是办法等着创新，还有的是硬币等着赚！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Like my first gig for example, Delivery! The idea came from the clam business.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]比如我的第一门生意，配送！这主意就来自蛤蜊生意。
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]比如我的第一门生意，配送！这主意就来自蛤蜊生意。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Critters would always come to us for clams.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]动物居民总是来找我们买蛤蜊。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]动物居民总是来找我们买蛤蜊。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]But what if WE came to THEM?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]可要是换成我们去找他们呢？
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]可要是换成我们去找他们呢？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]And not just for clams, but anything!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]而且不光送蛤蜊，什么都能送！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]而且不光送蛤蜊，什么都能送！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]That was where I got my big start, and I’ve only grown since then.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]我就是靠这个起步的，从那以后，生意就越做越大了。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]我就是靠这个起步的，从那以后，生意就越做越大了。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]This little town caught my interest for a number of reasons.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]这个小镇吸引我的地方可不少。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]这个小镇吸引我的地方可不少。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]It’s also been the testing grounds for my newest business ventures!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]这里也成了我尝试最新创业点子的地方！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]这里也成了我尝试最新创业点子的地方！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]Though, it’s not been all glam and success, Red, no sir.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]不过，小红，可也不是样样都风光、件件都成功。真不是。
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]不过，小红，可也不是样样都风光、件件都成功。真不是。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]Don’t even ask me about Clam Coin…
Clam Coin?
[pic=2]Oh man, Red - didn’t I tell ya not to ask me about Clam Coin?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]哎哟，小红，我不是说了，别问我蛤蜊币的事吗？
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]哎哟，小红，我不是说了，别问我蛤蜊币的事吗？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]It’s a long story, are you sure you want to know?
No, maybe some other time.
[pic=1]That’s what I thought, Red. Don’t open the wound that is Clam Coin.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]我就知道，小红。蛤蜊币这道伤疤，还是别揭了。
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]我就知道，小红。蛤蜊币这道伤疤，还是别揭了。

fields.Dialogue Text: Yes, let me hear it.
[pic=2]Aight, well now you’re in for it.
[pic=2]Back when delivering was booming - I was still working closely with clams. So I decided, instead of normal trades and deals - why not make a coin.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]当时配送生意正红火，我做的还是跟蛤蜊密切相关的买卖。所以我想，与其照常交易和换货，为什么不做种硬币呢？
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]当时配送生意正红火，我做的还是跟蛤蜊密切相关的买卖。所以我想，与其照常交易和换货，为什么不做种硬币呢？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]This coin can have a “fixed value” and can stand in and be traded for a clam.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]这种币可以有一个“固定价值”，能代替一只蛤蜊，也能换回一只蛤蜊。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]这种币可以有一个“固定价值”，能代替一只蛤蜊，也能换回一只蛤蜊。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Sounds simple enough, right?
[pic=3]Well I didn’t make too many clam coins at first. There was maybe… 20 or so in circulation.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]一开始我没做多少蛤蜊币。流通的大概也就……20枚左右。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]一开始我没做多少蛤蜊币。流通的大概也就……20枚左右。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]WELL RED.
[pic=2]TURNS OUT.
[pic=2]There’s a lot more to critters than simple values. This ain’t no 1 + 1 Red, no no no.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]动物居民的心思，可不是简单定个价就能算清的。不是做个1 + 1的算术就行，小红，远没那么简单。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]动物居民的心思，可不是简单定个价就能算清的。不是做个1 + 1的算术就行，小红，远没那么简单。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Because everyone wanted these dang coins, Red. Everyone.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]因为大家都想要这些该死的币啊，小红。所有人都想要。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]因为大家都想要这些该死的币啊，小红。所有人都想要。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]So I had to make more coins.
[pic=2]So here I am, slaving away, making coins. Meanwhile, we’ve got a buncha different Critters wanting coins for different reasons.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]于是我在这边拼死拼活地造币，另一边，不同的动物居民却各有各的理由，都想要币。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]于是我在这边拼死拼活地造币，另一边，不同的动物居民却各有各的理由，都想要币。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Critters that actually use the coin to redeem clams. Critters that want the coin just to HAVE it.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]有些是真的拿币来兑换蛤蜊。有些只是想把币留在手里。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]有些是真的拿币来兑换蛤蜊。有些只是想把币留在手里。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]And a profit indeed did they sell them at.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]而且他们倒卖起来，还真赚了钱。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]而且他们倒卖起来，还真赚了钱。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]I didn’t realize it, but I’m giving these clam coins away with the intention that critters will be redeeming 1 clam for them.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]我当时没意识到，可我发这些蛤蜊币，原本是想着大家能拿它们换1只蛤蜊。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]我当时没意识到，可我发这些蛤蜊币，原本是想着大家能拿它们换1只蛤蜊。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Yet some are turning a single clam coin into much more - 2, 3, 5x the clams worth in value!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]可有些人，能把一枚蛤蜊币炒到高得多——能换到原来2、3、5倍价值的蛤蜊！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]可有些人，能把一枚蛤蜊币炒到高得多——能换到原来2、3、5倍价值的蛤蜊！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Red I kid you not, some of the very neighbors here have a PROBLEM with finances.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]小红，我可没开玩笑，就咱们这里的某些邻居，理财真有问题。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]小红，我可没开玩笑，就咱们这里的某些邻居，理财真有问题。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]I don’t wanna name names Red… But a certain “Cotton Tail?” Yeah. She did not come out on top of Clam Coin.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]小红，我就不点名了……不过，某位“棉花尾巴”？对。她可没在蛤蜊币上占到便宜。
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]小红，我就不点名了……不过，某位“棉花尾巴”？对。她可没在蛤蜊币上占到便宜。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]It’s a good thing we don’t have real currencies or some critters would be homeless, definitely.

给我讲讲鸣铃祝福节。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]Oh? Isn’t it a little early to be thinking of that?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]哦？现在就想这个，是不是有点早？
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]哦？现在就想这个，是不是有点早？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]It’s the middle of Summer after all…
[pic=4]Er wait, have you celebrated The Blessing before?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]呃，等等，你以前庆祝过鸣铃祝福节吗？
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]呃，等等，你以前庆祝过鸣铃祝福节吗？

fields.Dialogue Text:
I’ve just learned about it.
Penny said you could tell me more.

targets.oldTarget:
我刚听说这个节日。
潘妮说，你能告诉我更多。
targets.newTarget:
我刚听说这个节日。
潘妮说，你能告诉我更多。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Ah yes, you’ve come to the right gator!
[pic=4]Knowing Penny, she’s likely told you the cultural and historical significance already?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]以我对潘妮的了解，她应该已经给你讲过其中的文化和历史意义了吧？
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]以我对潘妮的了解，她应该已经给你讲过其中的文化和历史意义了吧？

fields.Dialogue Text: Yep!
[pic=4]Great!
[pic=2]I’m assuming she told you to come to me to hear about The Saint?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]我猜，她让你来找我，是想让你听听圣者的故事？
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]我猜，她让你来找我，是想让你听听圣者的故事？

fields.Dialogue Text: She mentioned that.
[pic=5]Haha, I bet she wasn’t too keen on telling you that part…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]哈哈，我猜她不太乐意讲那一段……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]哈哈，我猜她不太乐意讲那一段……

fields.Dialogue Text: It seemed a little forced…

targets.oldTarget: 她提起时好像有点勉强……
targets.newTarget: 她提起时好像有点勉强……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Indeed… See cultural holidays will vastly change over generations.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]确实……你看，传统节日在一代代流传中，会发生很大的变化。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]确实……你看，传统节日在一代代流传中，会发生很大的变化。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]It can be hard to tell what stemmed from legitimacy, and what was added for fun.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]哪些有真实的渊源，哪些是为了好玩才加进去的，有时很难分清。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]哪些有真实的渊源，哪些是为了好玩才加进去的，有时很难分清。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]To Penny’s credit, I can’t say I’ve seen records of "The Saint" being involved with The Blessing…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]潘妮说的也有道理，我确实没见过“圣者”参与鸣铃祝福节的记载……
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]潘妮说的也有道理，我确实没见过“圣者”参与鸣铃祝福节的记载……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]But as a child, this aspect was a favorite of mine for the festivities. I’m definitely guilty of perpetuating this nonsense, but it’s so fun!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]不过小时候，我最喜欢的庆祝环节就是这个。我确实也在推波助澜，把这套胡说八道传下去，可它实在太有趣了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]不过小时候，我最喜欢的庆祝环节就是这个。我确实也在推波助澜，把这套胡说八道传下去，可它实在太有趣了！

fields.Dialogue Text: So what is it?
[pic=4]Right - so, you’re generally familiar with the origins of The Blessing of the Bells?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]对，说回正题。鸣铃祝福节的由来，你大致都知道了吧？
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]对，说回正题。鸣铃祝福节的由来，你大致都知道了吧？

fields.Dialogue Text: Yep!
[pic=2]Well it’s been said that there was a mysterious critter going around providing small boons and gifts to the young.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]据说，当时有一位神秘的居民四处走动，给年幼的孩子送去一点帮助和礼物。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]据说，当时有一位神秘的居民四处走动，给年幼的孩子送去一点帮助和礼物。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]Likely to keep their mind off of such perilous times.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]大概是想让他们暂时忘却那险恶的处境。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]大概是想让他们暂时忘却那险恶的处境。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Again, no official records of that happening - But the myth became tradition!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]还是那句话，没有正式记载能证实这件事。不过，传说渐渐成了传统！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]还是那句话，没有正式记载能证实这件事。不过，传说渐渐成了传统！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]It’s customary to give each other gifts during this holiday, but it’s also customary to give some gifts in total anonymity, thus continuing on the spirit of "The Saint".

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]节日期间，大家习惯互赠礼物，也习惯完全匿名地送出一些礼物，以此延续“圣者”的精神。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]节日期间，大家习惯互赠礼物，也习惯完全匿名地送出一些礼物，以此延续“圣者”的精神。

fields.Dialogue Text: Oooh that sounds fun!
[pic=8]It’s a blast!
[pic=4]And there’s no secret that I try to play that role during our celebrations…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]我每年过节都试着扮演这个角色，也不是什么秘密……
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]我每年过节都试着扮演这个角色，也不是什么秘密……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Believe me, it’s QUITE TRICKY for a fella like me to provide gifts without being noticed…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]相信我，像我这样的家伙，想悄悄送礼不被发现，可真是难上加难……
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]相信我，像我这样的家伙，想悄悄送礼不被发现，可真是难上加难……

fields.Dialogue Text: Haha, I’d imagine!
[pic=5]But the most interesting part Rascal…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]不过，小淘气，最有趣的地方是……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]不过，小淘气，最有趣的地方是……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]Even I receive some of these anonymous gifts… Like truly anonymous.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]就连我，也会收到这样的匿名礼物……是完全不知道谁送的那种。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]就连我，也会收到这样的匿名礼物……是完全不知道谁送的那种。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]See, it’s always easy to tell when a critter here is "trying" to be secretive.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]你看，这里的居民“试图”保密时，总是很容易看穿。
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]你看，这里的居民“试图”保密时，总是很容易看穿。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]But I’ll occasionally get a truly mysterious gift, and try as I might, no one seems to know where it comes from.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]可偶尔，我真会收到来历不明的礼物，无论怎么打听，似乎都没人知道是谁送的。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]可偶尔，我真会收到来历不明的礼物，无论怎么打听，似乎都没人知道是谁送的。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]All the critters know I’m supposed to be "The Saint" - so they often think I’m messing with them.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]居民们都知道，我才是扮演“圣者”的那位，所以他们常以为我在逗他们。
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]居民们都知道，我才是扮演“圣者”的那位，所以他们常以为我在逗他们。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]But I swear to you, I’ve no idea who keeps gifting me things during the festivities.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]但我向你发誓，我真的不知道，是谁在节日期间一直送我东西。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]但我向你发誓，我真的不知道，是谁在节日期间一直送我东西。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Obviously it’s gotta be a critter here, and really I’m just happy to see the spirit of The Saint living on.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]显然，肯定是这里的某位居民。说真的，看到圣者的精神传承下去，我就很开心了。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]显然，肯定是这里的某位居民。说真的，看到圣者的精神传承下去，我就很开心了。

fields.Dialogue Text: That sounds mysterious indeed!
[pic=4]Anyways, will you be joining us for this year’s Blessing?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]总之，今年的鸣铃祝福节，你会来和我们一起过吗？
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]总之，今年的鸣铃祝福节，你会来和我们一起过吗？

fields.Dialogue Text: I hope so! It sounds amazing!
[pic=2]It really is a special time here for us.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]对我们来说，那确实是一段很特别的时光。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]对我们来说，那确实是一段很特别的时光。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]I know I don’t speak for myself when I say we’d love to have you!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]我们都很欢迎你来，这话可不只代表我自己！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]我们都很欢迎你来，这话可不只代表我自己！

fields.Dialogue Text: Thanks for telling me about all of this!
[pic=8]Thanks for listening!
[pic=6]Bundling up in warm cloooothes, hanging with your paaals!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]裹着暖和的衣——裳，和好朋——友们待在一起！
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]裹着暖和的衣——裳，和好朋——友们待在一起！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Have a few drinks and we’re singing songs together, it’s such a good time!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]喝上几杯，再一起唱唱歌，别提多开心了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]喝上几杯，再一起唱唱歌，别提多开心了！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Not to mention… the kissing booths…
Scarlett:
Now Mabel can definitely stretch! But that toy wasn’t small by any means.

targets.oldTarget: 梅布尔确实撑得开！可那玩具无论怎么说，也不算小。
targets.newTarget: 梅布尔确实撑得开！可那玩具无论怎么说，也不算小。

fields.Dialogue Text: Peter:
That’s right, I remember it took a bit of coaxing to get the tip in.

targets.oldTarget: 没错，我记得光是让头部进去，就得费些工夫慢慢来。
targets.newTarget: 没错，我记得光是让头部进去，就得费些工夫慢慢来。

fields.Dialogue Text: Scarlett:
But as I say! With enough lube, anything will fit!

targets.oldTarget: 不过我常说嘛！只要润滑剂够，什么都塞得下！
targets.newTarget: 不过我常说嘛！只要润滑剂够，什么都塞得下！

fields.Dialogue Text: Peter:
I gotta say love, I’ll never get tired of watching you prepare a lady…

targets.oldTarget: 亲爱的，不得不说，看你给姑娘们做准备，我真是怎么看都看不腻……
targets.newTarget: 亲爱的，不得不说，看你给姑娘们做准备，我真是怎么看都看不腻……

fields.Dialogue Text: *Fade to Scene 2*
Now, that toy has some girth to it. It really widens at the center of the shaft. She was loving it!

targets.oldTarget: 那玩具可挺粗的。杆身中段尤其宽。她喜欢得不得了！
targets.newTarget: 那玩具可挺粗的。杆身中段尤其宽。她喜欢得不得了！

fields.Dialogue Text: At that point she was just in pure bliss. You could hear it in her squeaks and moans!

targets.oldTarget: 到那时候，她已经完全沉浸在极乐中了。听她吱吱地叫、哼哼地呻吟就知道！
targets.newTarget: 到那时候，她已经完全沉浸在极乐中了。听她吱吱地叫、哼哼地呻吟就知道！

fields.Dialogue Text: Every time she orgasms, there’s this lil twitch in her leg. Keep an eye out for it, it’s super cute!

targets.oldTarget: 她每次高潮，腿都会轻轻抽一下。留意看看，可爱极了！
targets.newTarget: 她每次高潮，腿都会轻轻抽一下。留意看看，可爱极了！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=5]She’s my roommate…
Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?

targets.oldTarget: 芬利的东西是不是在你们这儿？
targets.newTarget: 芬利的东西是不是在你们这儿？

fields.Dialogue Text: Charlotte
[pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]哦，是的，我们把他的东西装进了一个箱子。
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]哦，是的，我们把他的东西装进了一个箱子。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]我们还以为他会过来取，可是……
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]我们还以为他会过来取，可是……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=6]大概是我们把他逼得太过了……
targets.newTarget: [pic=6]大概是我们把他逼得太过了……

fields.Dialogue Text: Melody
[pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=7]是啊——我们确实把他的付出当成理所当然了。
targets.newTarget: [pic=7]是啊——我们确实把他的付出当成理所当然了。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=7]你看，小淘气，跟我们当室友，可真够人受的……
targets.newTarget: [pic=7]你看，小淘气，跟我们当室友，可真够人受的……

fields.Dialogue Text: Charlotte
[pic=6]And he’s a bit high maintenenance…
Melody
[pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=7]但我们确实应该再多用点心……
targets.newTarget: [pic=7]但我们确实应该再多用点心……

fields.Dialogue Text: Charlotte
[pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!
[pic=5]Give me a second…
[pic=1]Thanks Rascal! This is very nice of you!

Actually they’re from Charlotte and Melody!
I’m just the delivery boy.

targets.oldTarget:
其实是夏洛特和梅洛迪送的！
我只是个送货小哥。
targets.newTarget:
其实是夏洛特和梅洛迪送的！
我只是个送货小哥。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]Oh wonderful! Charlotte’s an excellent baker!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]哦，太好了！夏洛特的烘焙手艺可棒了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]哦，太好了！夏洛特的烘焙手艺可棒了！

fields.Dialogue Text:
They wanna be more active
with the critters down here.

targets.oldTarget:
她们想多和下面的
动物居民们来往。
targets.newTarget:
她们想多和下面的
动物居民们来往。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]That’s great news!
[pic=2]If it isn’t Rascal! How are you dear?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]这不是小淘气嘛！亲爱的，你好吗？
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]这不是小淘气嘛！亲爱的，你好吗？

fields.Dialogue Text:
I’m good! And I’ve got
cookies for the two of you!

targets.oldTarget:
我很好！还给你们俩
带了曲奇来！
targets.newTarget:
我很好！还给你们俩
带了曲奇来！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]What!
[pic=5]Hold on love! I’ll make sure they aren’t poison…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]亲爱的，先等等！我来试试有没有毒……
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]亲爱的，先等等！我来试试有没有毒……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]Of course, I’ll need to test yours as well…
Scarlett
[pic=7]Pfff, you wish!
[pic=7]If these are poison, it’ll just be the end of me!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=7]要是真有毒，那我也就一命呜呼了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=7]要是真有毒，那我也就一命呜呼了！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Also, how dare you insinuate our lil’ Rascal would poison us!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=4]还有，你居然敢暗示咱们的小淘气会毒死我们！
targets.newTarget: [pic=4]还有，你居然敢暗示咱们的小淘气会毒死我们！

fields.Dialogue Text: Actually they aren’t made by me!
[pic=3]Oh? Who are they from then?
Do you two know Charlotte and Melody?

targets.oldTarget: 你们俩认识夏洛特和梅洛迪吗？
targets.newTarget: 你们俩认识夏洛特和梅洛迪吗？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Ah yes! The critters up North. They don’t frequent these parts too often.

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]啊，认识！住在北边的那两位。她们不怎么来这边。
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]啊，认识！住在北边的那两位。她们不怎么来这边。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]I’ve always wanted to make a trek up there and meet them. But it’s awfully cold up there!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]我一直想上去一趟，认识认识她们。可那儿实在太冷了！
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]我一直想上去一趟，认识认识她们。可那儿实在太冷了！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=8]How did you bear it?
Claire and Violet knitted me a sweater.

targets.oldTarget: 克莱尔和维奥莱特给我织了件毛衣。
targets.newTarget: 克莱尔和维奥莱特给我织了件毛衣。

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]Oh! I bet you’re absolutely adorable in it!
It’s actually pretty itchy.
[pic=2]Ah you’ll get used to it!
[pic=1]Funny thing about those critters up north…

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]说起北边那两位，有件挺逗的事……
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]说起北边那两位，有件挺逗的事……

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=2]I haven’t met them, but I was out scavenging, and the bear… Charlotte, was it?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]我还没跟她们正式认识，不过有回我在外头找东西，那位熊……叫夏洛特来着？
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]我还没跟她们正式认识，不过有回我在外头找东西，那位熊……叫夏洛特来着？

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]She’s awfully quiet for how large she is!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=3]她个头那么大，走路却一点声都没有！
targets.newTarget: [pic=3]她个头那么大，走路却一点声都没有！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=1]She managed to sneak up on me, and I ended up having a bit of a fright!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]她悄没声地就到了我跟前，着实把我吓了一跳！
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]她悄没声地就到了我跟前，着实把我吓了一跳！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=3]I didn’t quite realize who it was, so I bolted.
[pic=2]It dawned on me later, but I never got the chance to mention it! It’d be a laugh now!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]后来我才反应过来，可一直没机会提起这事！现在说起来肯定很好笑！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]后来我才反应过来，可一直没机会提起这事！现在说起来肯定很好笑！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=7]That’s right! You had quite a fright that day.
[pic=2]It’s not every day you see a bear in the woods!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]在树林里见到熊，可不是天天都有的事！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]在树林里见到熊，可不是天天都有的事！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=7]True!
She’s quite harmless.
[pic=2]Of course…
[pic=5]… Or, did she poison these cookies to finish the job?!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]……还是说，她在曲奇里下了毒，好把我彻底解决掉？！
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]……还是说，她在曲奇里下了毒，好把我彻底解决掉？！

fields.Dialogue Text: [pic=4]Oh stop it Peter!
[pic=2]Haha, just havin’ a jab.
[pic=1]Now really, hand over those cookies!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=1]这回说真的，快把曲奇给我吧！
targets.newTarget: [pic=1]这回说真的，快把曲奇给我吧！

fields.Dialogue Text: Violet
[pic=5]… Hmm, no. I smell other critters on him… Melody?

targets.oldTarget: [pic=5]……嗯，不对。他身上有别的动物居民的气味……梅洛迪？
targets.newTarget: [pic=5]……嗯，不对。他身上有别的动物居民的气味……梅洛迪？

fields.Dialogue Text: Claire
[pic=4]Oh SNAP are these from Charlotte?
Yep, that’s right! You know them?
Claire
[pic=2]Of course! Melody is our girl!

targets.oldTarget: [pic=2]当然！梅洛迪可是我们的好姐妹！
targets.newTarget: [pic=2]当然！梅洛迪可是我们的好姐妹！

fields.Dialogue Text: Violet
